risks.title: Cutover step has no owner

evidence.quote: A5: Switch the application to the new cluster

risks.scenario: The application switch happens on the night with nobody accountable, so a failed switch waits for someone to volunteer while billing writes are down.
risks.detection: Ask on the rehearsal day who presses the switch; no name means the risk is live.
risks.mitigation: Name one person for A5 and one named backup before the rehearsal.

risks.title: Data copy scheduled before the cluster exists
risks.scenario: A3 is dated 2026-03-03 but A2, the cluster it needs, is dated 2026-03-04, so the copy cannot start on time and the freeze window is spent waiting.
risks.detection: Check on 2026-03-03 whether the new cluster accepts connections.
risks.mitigation: Move A3 after A2 or move A2 earlier, and add one spare day between them.

risks.title: Firewall ports depend on another team

evidence.quote: after the network team opens the firewall ports

risks.scenario: The network team is not named, has no date and is not a step, so the cluster build stalls silently while the schedule keeps its dates.
risks.detection: Ticket for the firewall change still open one week before A2.
risks.mitigation: Add a step for the firewall request with a named requester and a due date.

risks.title: No way back after the switch

evidence.absent: No rollback or fallback step exists for the cutover.

risks.scenario: If error rates stay high after A5 there is no written path back to the old host, so the team improvises under pressure.
risks.detection: Error rate above the goal threshold in the first 30 minutes after the switch.
risks.mitigation: Write a rollback step with a trigger threshold and a time limit, and rehearse it in A4.

risks.title: Runbooks have no owner or date
risks.scenario: Runbooks are not updated before cutover, so the on-call person follows stale instructions during the first incident on the new cluster.
risks.detection: Runbook page last-edited date is older than the cutover date.
risks.mitigation: Assign an owner and a date before the rehearsal.

not_checked: Whether the 5 minute downtime goal is achievable for this database size
Vendor delivery dates for the new cluster
